answer_1.quote: We illustrate the effectiveness of student models trained via this pipeline as the linchpin of TREE-WISE, a novel entailment tree engine that performs hypothesis proving via decompositional entailment search.

answer_2.quote: Our metric is F-score (β = 0.5), putting double precedence on precision over recall... We also display precision and recall in Table ... We introduce a new model-based tree integrity score.

answer_3.quote: Given the same instructions as our human annotators, GPT-4 can serve as a "teacher" in a knowledge distillation pipeline that annotates reasoning traces... We use GPT-4 to score each tree's component entailment steps under the RDTE protocol.

answer_4.quote: Four of this paper's authors, all highly proficient or native English speakers, annotated 1000 decompositions total with two-way redundancy. One author annotated all items... We first annotated several examples together to develop a list of 30+ condition checks...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators followed an informal‑logic‑inspired protocol using Relevance, Acceptability, and Sufficiency (RAS) criteria with detailed condition lists.
